en.title: Run both original Egret 5.3 native display interfaces
en.body: Select the native display interface from the original engine. Package original scripts with classic JavaScript semantics and share the Android player’s texture ownership and touch dispatch across both interfaces.

zh.title: Android 播放器支持两代白鹭 5.3 原生显示接口
zh.body: 从原引擎文件识别显示接口，按经典 JavaScript 语义执行原版脚本。两代接口复用同一播放器的纹理管理和触控事件。
